name: 客服 SOP
description: 把产品资料整理成客服规程，再用对话用例检查缺口，最后收成一份可评测的 Skill。 / Turn product notes into a support SOP, check it against sample conversations, and package an evaluable skill.

product.description: 产品名称，例如：澄光台灯 / Product name, e.g. Chenguang desk lamp

tone.description: 客服语气 / Tone of the replies

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English。决定规程、用例、检查报告和脚本日志的语言 / Output language: zh or en. Sets the language of the SOP, cases, review and script logs

stages.name: 资料
stages.description: 放入 FAQ、产品说明和退换货政策。 / Add the FAQ, product notes and return policy.

executor.instructions: 把 FAQ、产品说明和退换货政策放进 knowledge/，文件用 .md 或 .txt。可以先复制 example-knowledge/：把 example-knowledge/ 里的文件复制到 knowledge/。 / Put the FAQ, product notes and return policy in knowledge/ as .md or .txt files. To start, copy the files from example-knowledge/ into knowledge/.

stages.name: 汇总
stages.description: 按文件名把 knowledge/ 里的文本合并成一份 knowledge.md。模型阶段只能看到文件夹的文件列表，所以必须先汇总。 / Merge the text files in knowledge/ into knowledge.md, one heading per file name. Model stages only see a directory as a file list, so this step is required.

stages.name: 规程
stages.description: 写出适用范围、常见意图、每个意图的处理步骤、何时转人工，以及绝对不能说的话。 / Write the scope, common intents, handling steps for each intent, when to hand off to a human, and what never to say.

stages.name: 用例
stages.description: 根据规程编一组测试对话：顾客原话、意图、期望处理。 / Write test conversations from the SOP: the customer's words, the intent, and the expected handling.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 对照每条用例，写出规程是否覆盖、缺口和修改建议。 / For each case, say whether the SOP handles it, plus gaps and suggested fixes.

stages.name: 技能
stages.description: 把规程收成 Skill（name、description，正文是 SOP），并带上用例作为评测集。 / Package the SOP as a skill (name, description, body is the SOP) plus the cases as an eval set.
